items.title: Sandisk, eBay, AppLovin, Goodyear: After-Hours Stocks to Watch

Shares edged 1% higher in postmarket trading. ↗️ Goodyear Tire & Rubber (GT): The company swung to a second-quarter loss as lower tire sales volume combined with higher costs.

items.title: Western Digital Stock Declines After Earnings Report
items.summary: Western Digital stock was down 11% in after-hours trading after the company released its earnings report. It reported a profit of $3.2 billion, compared with $282 million a year earlier. Earnings from continuing operations were $8.

items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Q4 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.27% and +1.14%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Western Digital Earnings Beat With 44% Sales Growth. But Stock Tumbles Late.
items.summary: Western Digital stock slid late Wednesday despite the hard-disk drive maker reporting fiscal fourth-quarter results ahead of estimates.  Western Digital, which recently rebranded as WD, said its adjusted earnings climbed 109% to $3.56 per share for the June quarter.  WD and its rival Seagate Technology dominate the hard-disk drive market.
